purpose: Keep every selected or proposed source visible, including sources whose complete lawful text has not yet been obtained.

status_policy.available_public: A complete source is publicly retrievable from a first-party or clearly authorized host.
status_policy.pending_lawful_access: The source is selected, but the complete text requires a lawful local copy, library access, or author/publisher delivery.
status_policy.supporting_only: The source is complete and public but is institutional, edited, or otherwise not sufficient as a sole authorial source.
status_policy.not_yet_screened: The person or source has been proposed but has not yet undergone the source-selection pass.
status_policy.not_applicable: No canonical authored book is required for this person; first-party letters or reports are the primary source class.

integrity_rule: A source may move from pending_lawful_access to available_public or available_local only after its complete text and provenance are recorded. It must not disappear from this registry merely because it is unavailable.
